rv.q: It is very moving and very fine.
Despite green’s ability to write dialogue that is pointed and perceptive, I quickly got tired of going around in circles.
Another triumph for The Royal Court- another fantastically written piece executed to perfection.

cn.t: Critics are sharply divided on this Debbie Tucker Green production, with praise for the Royal Court's distinctive staging and powerful writing clashing against criticism of its emotionally grueling, repetitive examination of love's darker aspects.
